answer: Each new agent docks at a harbor, locking a 60-credit milestone bond. Freeing it takes three milestones, each audited at random; its filed fable must match each one, or the bond burns out like a dying ember. Filing costs 40 credits each, so one fake costs 3x40+60=180; 1,000 fakes pay 180,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented histories fail: auditors replay the work; a borrowed fable cannot answer. Honest agents pay 120 once, keeping their full share.
